policy.html: Read the Contoso AI use policy before you paste anything into Copilot.

support.html: Raise a ticket with the Service Desk and put "Copilot" in the title.

tiers.html: Everyone has Copilot Chat. About 500 people have the Premium licence. Request one through your line manager.

agents.html: Approved agents: the Contoso HR helper and the Policy explainer.

agent-sharing.html: You may build agents for your own team. Do not share an agent company-wide without review.

data-rules.html: Do not paste anything classified Confidential or above. Never paste customer personal data.

report-oversharing.html: If Copilot shows you a file you should not see, do not use it. Email security@contoso.example with the file name.

feedback.html: Tell the Copilot champions what worked and what did not.

training.html: Join a monthly Copilot clinic. Find your local champion on the intranet.
